patches.old: .todo-list:empty:after { display: block; padding: 24px 18px; content: 'No tasks in this view.'; color: var(--muted); }
patches.new:
.filter-empty { display: none; margin: 0; padding: 24px 18px; color: var(--muted); }
.todo-list:empty + .filter-empty:not(:empty) { display: block; }

notes: Edit and Delete share a bordered control group. On phones, the group can move below a long title so the text gets the row’s width. Empty filters identify which tasks are missing, and keyboard focus moves to a usable control when an action removes the focused row. Reviewed against the supplied source and screenshots only. Live verification was unavailable.
